representation: native loopback UDP QUIC and TCP database capture; no stream carrier substitution

producer.quic: aioquic 1.2.0 AES128GCM, two TLS ClientRandoms, H3 and DoQ

data: synthetic public fixture values and fixture-only credentials; key log is test-only
independent_oracle_notes: aioquic reconstructs both fragmented DoQ requests and returns the expected A records. TShark 4.4.8 decodes H3 and DoQ responses; its per-frame DoQ display marks split length-prefix request fragments malformed. The raw capture and that divergent output are retained. TSV lines have trailing whitespace removed.

bounded_profiles.quic: v1 Initial, AES128GCM keylog Handshake/1RTT, CID and zero-CID tuple, directional PN/stream/CRYPTO; key updates retain one previous generation
bounded_profiles.http3: ALPN h3, request/control/QPACK streams, blocked/resume, headers/data/trailers; push payload remains opaque
bounded_profiles.doq: ALPN doq, client bidirectional stream, ID zero, one DNS per direction plus FIN
bounded_profiles.mysql: classic protocol41 prepared with fresh metadata, execute type reuse, reset/close/fetch, binary scalars and rows; native samples use two clients against MariaDB common classic capabilities
bounded_profiles.postgresql: protocol3 observed statements/portals, extended cycle association, COPY IN/OUT native and BOTH unit profile, unknown OIDs remain raw
bounded_profiles.kafka: M2A version-accurate legacy profiles retained; ApiVersions3/Metadata9/Produce9/Fetch12 flexible remain a separate version extension

unsupported_extensions: MySQL LONG_DATA, compression, query attributes and optional/cached metadata
PostgreSQL arbitrary binary type interpretation and auth proof verification
